title: Ask by Name
prompt: The grimoire answers to names, not positions: spells['fire'] fetches by key. .get(key, fallback) does the same, but hands back the fallback instead of an error when the key is missing.

rounds.explain: Ask the dictionary by its KEY and it hands you the value. spells["fire"] is Ignis.
.get returns your fallback when the key is missing — 'Unknown' instead of a crash. That is asking politely.
